pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding positions within 5 minutes or 1.5 ATR of a prior entry; zero averaging down into falling knives.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory 5-EMA/21-EMA alignment plus volume delta confirmation greater than 1.5x rolling 20-period average before order execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate trailing structural stops once floating profit hits +$10.00 to prevent erosion to negative outcomes.
